verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only describes component-level state management ("components manage their own state") and interaction-driven updates, but never mentions React's built-in Context API, useReducer, or any documented pattern for sharing state globally without a third-party library like Redux/Zustand. Missing for 10: no citation of useContext/createContext, no discussion of prop-drilling avoidance, no guidance on app-wide state without external libraries.
